sourceTextIntegrity.canonicalization: UTF-8 of compact JSON.stringify([[id, exactSourceText], ...]) in plan order

semantics.FAIL: OPEN engineering/evidence closure, not a claim of a demonstrated software defect
semantics.NOT_MAPPED: Actual per-item source/owner/test/oracle mapping unfinished; static/research/coding work can continue, no runtime blocker inferred
semantics.BLOCKED: Explicit external-only action/trial with a documented actual prerequisite; existing unavailable execution tests remain blocked
semantics.candidateEvidence: Limited source/adapted assertion evidence is not whole-item PASS or native/browser/provider qualification
